title: Use Map Monitor Summary Drop-down to View Current AGV Faults
summary: Open the Map Monitor summary-area drop-down to reveal current AGV faults/errors that need attention (the drop-down may be hidden until a current fault exists).
when_to_use: Use when you need to quickly check whether there are current AGV faults/errors requiring attention from the Map Monitor summary area, especially when the drop-down is sometimes hidden until a current fault exists.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the Map Monitor summary-area drop-down and review the listed current AGV faults/errors for next-step troubleshooting.
Escalation (if needed): If the drop-down does not show faults while other indicators suggest faults, escalate for additional diagnostics beyond the summary drop-down.
access_or_tools_needed: Small drop-down control for current AGV faults/errors

visual_references.description: Map Monitor message panel area showing: open message panel, active robot count, robots charging count, small drop-down for AGV faults (sometimes hidden), and disconnected count.

steps.title: Locate the small drop-down area in the Map Monitor summary/message panel
steps.purpose: Find the control that reveals current AGV faults/errors (which may be hidden until a current fault exists).
steps.instruction: On the Map Monitor summary/message panel area, locate the small drop-down control described as sometimes hidden.
steps.expected_result: You can see the small drop-down area/control in the Map Monitor summary/message panel area (or you confirm it is currently hidden).
steps.healthy_condition: When a current fault that needs to be addressed exists, the drop-down is available to open from the summary/message panel area.
steps.failure_condition: The drop-down does not appear/does not become available even though you expect current faults to be present.

actions.label: Locate the small drop-down
actions.exact_action: Locate the small drop down here (sometimes this is hidden).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the drop-down does not show faults while other indicators suggest faults, escalate for additional diagnostics beyond the summary drop-down.

steps.title: Open the Map Monitor summary drop-down to reveal current AGV faults/errors
steps.purpose: Reveal the list of current AGV faults/errors that need attention.
steps.instruction: If the current-fault drop-down is available, click the drop-down menu to expand it and display the errors/faults.
steps.expected_result: The drop-down expands and shows the errors/faults listed as current AGV faults needing attention.
steps.healthy_condition: When current AGV faults exist, opening the drop-down reveals the errors/faults in the expanded menu.
steps.failure_condition: After clicking, the drop-down does not display any current AGV faults/errors (or remains unavailable).

actions.label: Click the drop-down menu
actions.exact_action: click that drop down menu and you will be able to see the errors.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the drop-down does not show faults while other indicators suggest faults, escalate for additional diagnostics beyond the summary drop-down.

steps.title: Review the displayed current AGV faults/errors for next-step troubleshooting
steps.purpose: Identify what faults/errors are currently reported so you can proceed with the appropriate troubleshooting path.
steps.instruction: Read the fault/error entries shown in the expanded drop-down and note what is listed for further troubleshooting.
steps.expected_result: You have a clear list of the current AGV errors/faults shown in the drop-down entries.
steps.healthy_condition: The drop-down entries correspond to current faults that need attention (i.e., the list is populated when current faults exist).
steps.failure_condition: The drop-down entries are empty or do not reflect expected fault conditions.

actions.label: Review drop-down entries
actions.exact_action: Review the displayed errors/faults and note what is listed for further troubleshooting.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the drop-down does not show faults while other indicators suggest faults, escalate for additional diagnostics beyond the summary drop-down.

success_criteria: The Map Monitor summary-area drop-down can be opened when current AGV faults exist.
The expanded drop-down displays the current AGV errors/faults that need attention.
healthy_conditions: Drop-down is sometimes hidden, but becomes available when a current fault that needs to be addressed exists.
Opening the drop-down reveals the errors/faults in the expanded menu.
failure_conditions: Drop-down remains hidden/unavailable even though you expect current faults to be present.
Drop-down opens but does not display current AGV faults/errors when faults are expected.
escalation_guidance: If the drop-down does not show faults while other indicators suggest faults, escalate for additional diagnostics beyond the summary drop-down.
